name: GiveDirectly (Founders Pledge benchmark)
beneficiaries_note: Nothing in the model says where; the charity's main country of operation, the one its other models name most: Kenya.
summary: Unconditional cash transfers to very poor households. Founders Pledge uses GiveDirectly as its yardstick and values it, in its 2022 sheets, at $164 per WELLBY-equivalent of its own value units; this model turns that benchmark into the income gain it stands for. It predates GiveWell's 2024 update and is about 2.7 times below GiveWell's current GiveDirectly model.

sections.title: Founders Pledge's benchmark
sections.explainer: Founders Pledge publishes no model of GiveDirectly; its recommendation rests on GiveWell's analysis, and its sheets use a fixed GiveDirectly benchmark derived from GiveWell's cash figure, the yardstick for its multiples of cash.

sections.title: From the benchmark to units of value
sections.explainer: charityevals' step: Founders Pledge's value units per dollar, turned back into the income gain they stand for with Founders Pledge's own weight on a doubled income, then valued like every income gain on the site.

sections.title: Staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Founders Pledge's: with credit by share of resources on, staff's pay below what they could earn elsewhere counts as an in-kind contribution and gets its share of the outcome. Off by default.

rows.label: GiveDirectly's cost per WELLBY-equivalent (Founders Pledge, 2022)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's figure in its 2022 mass media sheets ("164/$ WELLBY for GD", FEM tab B32), the shared Founders Pledge fact. Its 2023 Imagine Worldwide sheet uses about $171 from its internal GiveDirectly analysis. These 'WELLBYs' are Founders Pledge's value units (3.7 per healthy year, 1.9 per doubled income-year), not survey life-satisfaction points. Founders Pledge's sheets use $157 to $171 for the same benchmark (±4%).

rows.label: Founders Pledge's value units per dollar
Founders Pledge's value units per unit of ln(income)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's 2022 weight for doubling one person's income for a year (1.898) per unit of ln(income).

rows.label: Increase in ln(income) per dollar
rows.explainer: Cash transfers' benefit is income, so Founders Pledge's value units are turned back into the income gain they stand for.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar
rows.explainer: Valued with the site's weight on income: about 0.0032 units of value per dollar. Founders Pledge's figure is GiveWell's pre-2024 cash benchmark (0.00335) restated in Founders Pledge's units, so it isn't independent of GiveWell. GiveWell's November 2024 GiveDirectly model, which adds spillovers, mortality and later-year gains, gives about 2.7 times this.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: About 83% of GiveDirectly's spending reaches recipients (Founders Pledge's page), so staff are at most the rest. Our judgment.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Field staff are mostly hired locally at local rates, so the gap is small. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.
